question: Among the patients whose total cholesterol is within the normal range, how many of them have a P pattern observed in the sheet of ANA examination?
evidence: total cholesterol is within the normal range refers to `T-CHO` < 250; P pattern observed in the sheet of ANA examination refers to ANA Pattern = 'P';
clarification: Count each distinct ID only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3."ANA Pattern" = 'P' AND T2."T-CHO" < 250
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.`ANA Pattern` = 'P' AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination AS e JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = e.ID WHERE e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P' AND l.`T-CHO` < 250

b.request: Count the distinct patient IDs with at least one Laboratory record where `T-CHO` < 250 and at least one Examination record where `ANA Pattern` = 'P'
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.`T-CHO` < 250 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination AS e WHERE e.ID = l.ID AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P')

d.request: How many distinct patient IDs have T-CHO < 250 and an ANA examination pattern of P?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`T-CHO` < 250 AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P'
